faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our platform

1.question: What exactly do I get with the Pro version?
1.answer: You get the complete source code, all components, authentication system, database setup, payment integration, and lifetime updates. Everything you need to build and launch your SaaS application.

2.question: Do I need to pay monthly fees?
2.answer: No! It's a one-time payment. You own the code forever and can use it for unlimited projects. The only recurring costs would be your own hosting and third-party services.

3.question: Can I use this for client projects?
3.answer: Yes! The Pro license includes commercial usage rights. You can use it for your own projects or client work without any additional fees.

4.question: How do updates work?
4.answer: You get lifetime access to all updates. When we release new features or improvements, you'll receive them at no additional cost.

5.question: What kind of support do I get?
5.answer: Pro users get priority support via email and access to our private Discord community where you can get help from our team and other developers.
